entities.name: Codex Vocifera
entities.description: Ancient animated, self-aware codex of the Strixhaven Biblioplex, nicknamed Codie.

entities.name: Zimone Wola
entities.description: Student whom Codie informed of the fate of her grandmother.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: Alternate version who Codie assisted in finding a Blood Age tome.

entities.name: Vaults of Turrau
entities.description: Place storing a Blood Age tome.

entities.name: Theorist
entities.description: Echoverse figure who restricts access to the Echoverse Codie.

entities.name: Hexhaven
entities.description: Echoverse location where an alternate Codie exists.

entities.name: Lorehold
entities.description: College whose scholars speculated tomes could animate themselves.

entities.description: College whose scholars speculated tomes could animate themselves.

events.summary: Lorehold and Silverquill scholars speculate that a tome could serve as a vessel for its own animative spellcasting.
events.quote: Lorehold and Silverquill scholars speculated that, under the proper conditions, a tome could serve as a vessel for its own animative spellcasting

events.summary: Zarida Mincely authors the Codex Vocifera.
events.quote: The Codex Vocifera was authored by Zarida Mincely between 91 and 249:2 MA.

events.summary: The codex self-actualizes after being checked out by students and transported through time.
Codie informs Zimone Wola about the fate of her grandmother.
events.quote: Codie played a key role in informing Zimone Wola about the fate of her grandmother

events.summary: Codie assists an alternate Ral Zarek in locating a Blood Age tome in the Vaults of Turrau.
events.quote: It later assisted an alternate Ral Zarek in locating a Blood Age tome stored in the Vaults of Turrau.
